detail.title: 4MP IR fixed focal Dome WizSense 4G Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HDBW3441DR1-AST-4G-EAU 4MP IR fixed focal Dome WizSense 4G Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Efficient H.264+/H.265+ Compression Technology • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • Supports Max. 256G Micro SD card • LTE-TDD/LTE-FDD 4G Wireless Network Transmission, Support Micro SIM Card • IP67 and IK10 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Quick Pick: With AI NVR, quickly pick up the human/vehicle targets that users are interested in from SMD events
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire, intrusion (support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
